name: @ledgerfit/openapi-core
description: OpenAPI contracts for Ledgerfit (common + identity + product domains)

scripts.bundle:domains: mkdir -p src/.bundled && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle identity --output src/.bundled/identity.json && redocly bundle ledgers --output src/.bundled/ledgers.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle ledgers --output src/.bundled/ledgers.json && redocly bundle training --output src/.bundled/training.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle training --output src/.bundled/training.json && redocly bundle models --output src/.bundled/models.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle models --output src/.bundled/models.json && redocly bundle triggers --output src/.bundled/triggers.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle triggers --output src/.bundled/triggers.json && redocly bundle provenance --output src/.bundled/provenance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle provenance --output src/.bundled/provenance.json && redocly bundle investigation --output src/.bundled/investigation.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle investigation --output src/.bundled/investigation.json && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.openapi.yaml && redocly bundle governance --output src/.bundled/governance.json
